features.note: Faithful, fully functional migration verified by direct observation. Structural gate reported cov 1/4 only because the NavigationView pane was collapsed at capture; after expanding it (screenshots/winui_nav_expanded.png) the full 13-scenario list, the 'Application Resources C# sample' title, the copyright, and the 'Trademarks | Privacy' footer links are all present. Scenario navigation is behaviorally live (selecting scenario 2 navigates — screenshots/winui_scenario2.png). Core feature works: the x:Uid-bound resource string 'Hello World' resolves from resources.resw. Trademarks/Privacy links are dead in-app in BOTH UWP and WinUI (external URLs), so no behavioral regression. Minor cosmetic: WinUI header rebranded 'Windows platform sample' -> 'Windows App SDK sample' and skips the UWP splash logo.
